title: Screenshots through Caduceus into satty (swappy fallback), with text-only Satty toasts on copy and save.
summary: Keys capture an area, full screen, or window through the Caduceus face door into satty (swappy where absent); Satty shows text-only toasts on copy and save.
description: Screenshot keys send capture requests through the Caduceus face door into satty (swappy where absent). Ctrl+C copies and Ctrl+S saves; either action shows a text-only Satty toast and closes, while Esc closes silently.
